title: Russian ESPO oil price exceeds $120 per barrel, traders say and data shows - reuters.com

title: Aramco halts October crude deliveries to some European refiners after pipeline attack, Bloomberg reports - reuters.com

title: Saudis Tell European Refiners They’ll Get No Crude Next Month - Bloomberg.com

title: Why One Saudi Pipeline Is Crucial to the Global Oil Market - Bloomberg.com
